title: Backup & restore
subtitle: Everything in one file you keep

restore.choose: Choose what to restore. Everything else stays as it is.
restore.tripFiles_one: {{count}} file, {{size}}; only for trips in the trips list
restore.tripFiles_other: {{count}} files, {{size}}; only for trips in the trips list

result.undo: Your data from before the restore was saved as {{file}}. Restore that file from the list below to undo.

status.notShared: Sharing is not available here; the file is in the list below.
status.failed: The backup could not be saved. See More → Error log for details.

pick.title: Restore from file
pick.unavailable: Choosing a file needs a newer build of the app. You can still restore a backup from the list below.
pick.help: Pick a backup file. You see what it holds and choose what to restore before anything changes.

confirm.title: Restore from this backup?
confirm.body: This replaces: {{what}}. Your current data is snapshotted first, so you can undo.
confirm.body2: The selected data on this phone is replaced by the backup. The adapter is disconnected first.

export.failed: The export could not be saved. See More → Error log for details.
export.title: Export one part
export.help: Share one kind of data on its own: JSON for any of them, CSV (opens in a spreadsheet) for history, module scans and the maintenance log.

backUp.title: Back up
backUp.help: One file with your garage, history, scans, trips, maintenance log, coding backups, alert rules and settings. It stays on this phone until you share it; keep a copy somewhere else. The file is plain text and holds your VINs, but never an AI API key.
backUp.estimate: The backup file will be about {{size}}.
backUp.large: This backup is large (about {{size}}). Sharing a file this big can fail.
backUp.largeTrips: This backup is large (about {{size}}). Sharing a file this big can fail; leave the trip recordings out to make a small backup.

list.title: Backups on this phone
list.help: The newest {{max}} backups are kept (the automatic snapshots taken before a restore are counted apart); an older file is deleted when a new one is saved. Share the ones you want to keep elsewhere.

err.read: The file could not be read.
err.open: The file could not be opened.
err.noStorage: This device has no app storage to restore into.
err.snapshot: The current data could not be saved first, so nothing was restored.
err.skipped: Could not be restored (see the error log).
err.noStorageShort: This device has no app storage.

reset.listFailed: Could not list the exported files to delete them.
